Security

Source: SECURITY.md

Reporting a problem

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Email the maintainer listed in the package’s DESCRIPTION file with what you found, how to reproduce it, and which version you used. You will get an answer as soon as possible; support is best effort, by one person.

Supported versions

The latest release on CRAN and the main branch on GitHub.

What dragonfarm does to keep you safe

The threat model lists what we defend against, how, what we measured, and what is still open. In short: models are pinned and loaded from safetensors only; Python packages are locked with hashes; agents can only do what the policy allows, and training, promotion, deletion and anything that leaves the machine wait for a person; everything that leaves the machine passes one check and is recorded; the record cannot be edited through dragonfarm or the database’s normal statements; keys live in the operating system’s keychain.
